research_gaps.question: Which of the observatory's sites does the Commonwealth Hosting Certification Framework register list as certified, and at what level?
research_gaps.why_it_matters: HCF certification decides which facilities may host Australian Government data. Every certification value in the record rested on a grade-B market directory, and 67 sites had none.
research_gaps.notes: RESOLVED 2026-10-10. Read the register's Certified Service Providers page (Internet Archive capture of 2026-09-28; the live site refused automated clients). It lists Strategic facilities and enclaves only; no Assured facility is listed. 26 site records match listed facilities, each on every facility the record names: SITE_AIRTRUNK_MEL1 (facility), SITE_AIRTRUNK_SYD1 (facility), SITE_AIRTRUNK_SYD2 (facility), SITE_CDC_BROOKLYN (facility), SITE_CDC_CANBERRA (facility), SITE_CDC_EC (facility), SITE_DCI_SYD01 (enclave), SITE_DR_ERSKINE (enclave), SITE_DR_MEL11 (enclave), SITE_EQUINIX_CA1 (facility), SITE_EQUINIX_MEL (enclave), SITE_EQUINIX_PER (enclave), SITE_EQUINIX_SYD (enclave), SITE_MACQ_FAIRBAIRN (facility), SITE_MACQ_IC12 (enclave), SITE_MACQ_IC3 (enclave), SITE_NEXTDC_A1 (enclave), SITE_NEXTDC_C1 (enclave), SITE_NEXTDC_D1 (enclave), SITE_NEXTDC_M123 (enclave), SITE_NEXTDC_P12 (enclave), SITE_NEXTDC_S1 (enclave), SITE_NEXTDC_S2 (enclave), SITE_NEXTDC_S3 (enclave), SITE_TELSTRA_DEAKIN (enclave), SITE_TELSTRA_STLEON (enclave). All 26 already held certified_strategic from SRC_CERTSTRAT; each now also cites the register, with the register's line quoted. No site gained a value. The sites not listed keep `unknown`: absence is not recorded as not_certified, because the register lists only certified providers and new registrations have been paused since 3 November 2025. Not applied: AirTrunk SYD3 is not listed (AirTrunk's certified facilities are SYD1, SYD2 and MEL1); Microsoft Azure is certified as a cloud service, which is not a facility certification; DigiCo SYD1 is a certified enclave in the existing facility, not the expansion project the site record describes.
